north_star: One human correction inside the current page context should enter a page-scoped change thread, become durable executable work, and return a concise visible result to the same Universal Host without requiring routing, result transport or a second mobile shell.

current_flow.interaction: Human stays inside the single Universal Host and current child page.
Notas / Cambios is page-scoped; text capture, private attachment intake, Page Change Threads and Page Change Feed exist in manifested V5 capabilities.
Disposable agent launching is exposed as a served capability, but launcher existence does not prove that a page-thread message becomes a validated execution packet and durable worker lifecycle.
Page Change Thread -> execution packet -> existing Execute path -> run/return refs -> feed linkage remains an active recovery lane with STARTED but no durable RETURN at this audit point.
Canonical visible results belong back inside the Universal Host at /?page=<page_id>&changes=<work_item_id>; raw child URLs are not the primary human surface.

friction_findings.finding: The human can enter a page-scoped change, but current durable evidence does not yet prove the full causal chain from that one message to execution and a visible returned result.
friction_findings.effect: The surface can look operational while the most important correction-to-result promise is still unproven.
friction_findings.correct_response: Finish and verify the existing Page Change Thread bridge lane; do not create a parallel messaging/execution system.

friction_findings.finding: The same thread/feed needs durable derived state for at least working, returned and problem plus the final host-routed result reference; served feed capability alone is not proof that execution states are linked.
friction_findings.effect: Without causal state, the human may need to inspect technical worker state or wonder whether the correction actually launched.
friction_findings.correct_response: Project existing claim/run/return evidence into the page feed once the bridge exists; projection remains derived, not authority.

friction_findings.finding: prometeo-mobile is a logical surface_id with no dedicated catalog page_id. Treating it visually as an independent app/page would imply an authority mapping that does not exist.
friction_findings.effect: Navigation or status UI could falsely suggest a second product surface.
friction_findings.correct_response: Keep host/page identity canonical and surface identity as planning/control metadata until an explicit mapping contract exists.

friction_findings.finding: No dedicated durable mobile-only human literal was found defining breakpoints, alternate gesture grammar or a separate compact layout.
friction_findings.effect: A redesign worker could regress accepted tactile behavior by filling source debt with generic mobile assumptions.
friction_findings.correct_response: Preserve served tactile/safe-area behavior; require explicit evidence before adding device-class-specific interaction laws.

friction_findings.finding: Global durable intent says human-visible output should be brief. Exposing claims, run IDs or coordination internals by default would turn the correction flow into a control dashboard.
friction_findings.effect: Higher cognitive load on mobile and leakage of implementation state into normal UX.
friction_findings.correct_response: Default to one concise human state/result line; expose technical lineage only behind optional detail.

preserve_first_invariants: Exactly one global Universal Control in the top-level host; no second mobile shell inferred from surface_id.
Child pages remain visually/functionally independent and do not receive duplicate global controls.
The approved tactile control remains repeatedly draggable, corner-snapping and semantic-corner-persistent.
Safe-area, resize, rotation and VisualViewport changes recompute placement.
Moving the closed control does not stop recording/background transcription.
Notas / Cambios remains page-scoped and canonical results return to the same Universal Host.
Human-facing state stays concise by default; technical evidence remains available but secondary.

sequence: Human submits one correction in page-scoped Notas / Cambios.
The message receives one durable thread/work identity without asking the human to route it.
The same surface shows a concise derived state such as working, result ready, or problem.
Execution reuses the existing Page Change Thread / Execute / claim-run-return machinery.
On RETURN, the thread/feed receives run and return refs and a canonical host deep link.
Opening the result keeps the human inside the Universal Host and current page context.
non_goals: no raw child URL as canonical result
no default exposure of worker coordination internals

verification_gates: A real page-thread message produces a validated execution packet through the existing execution path.
Exactly one exclusive execution owns the work item after collision/retry handling.
The page thread/feed receives run and return refs durably.
The human can reopen the result using the canonical root-host deep link.
Failure/stale state is visible without inventing completion.
Touch drag/regrab, safe-area/rotation and active-recording preservation remain unchanged.
non_obvious_findings: The dominant mobile UX problem is causal continuity from a page-scoped correction to a durable visible result, not screen layout.
The served UI already contains enough primitives for the target experience; another shell or messaging surface would increase complexity while bypassing the missing execution proof.
A concise state line in the existing thread/feed can satisfy low-friction UX while complete claim/run/return lineage stays durable underneath.

deduplication.decision: No duplicate opportunity emitted; the foundational causal gap already has an active recovery lane and existing mobile follow-up lanes cover integration/risk/planning.
